13 system-spec-kit suites run only in the report-only job

label: The system-spec-kit runtime tree holds 352 test files: 339 .vitest.ts reachable by the vitest projects and 13 .test.mjs matched only by run-node-tests.
The 13 node:test files cover gate menus, permissions, recorded failures and four mirror generators, yet they only run in the continue-on-error advisory job, so they cannot turn a check red.
spec-gate-core.test.mjs is 2689 lines, the largest test file in the tree, and it is one of the 13 files in the non-blocking path.

The three basenames shared by cli/tests and tests/ are layered rather than duplicated: the CLI copies drive child processes and the runtime copies exercise modules in process, so neither side is deletable on this evidence.
Eight files carry about 12100 test lines, and progressive validation alone is tested at two layers with 1198 and 903 lines, making it the strongest narrowing candidate.
The 595 s spec-kit-check mean covers 339 vitest files plus legacy and bash lanes with 214 of those files under runtime/cli, and no per-project duration is stored.

direction: Deleting same-named suites that appear in both cli/tests and tests/
reason: Their imports show different layers and mechanisms, so they are layered coverage rather than duplicates.
